leg7.caption: Gifford et al. 2014 Lab Chip 14, 4496–4505, Fig. 6 (the micrograph; scale from the printed 125 µm centre, 4.5248 µm/px; the rows at 49.81° on the image) with the mask gifford2014_fig6_aligned: the end of leg 7 (the image's top leg; cyan: the reproduction claim, its posts, channels and walls to 60 µm into the divider wall that starts one gap after the last post; amber: the turn or outlet stretch beyond).  Registration: scale and rotation from the printed centre width and the rows on the image, rotation measured on the image; translation fitted on features and, independently, by chamfer matching (they agree within 0.0 / 0.2 px along / across).  Nearest-outline offset: median 0.64 µm, 90th percentile 1.74 µm (n 2245); for comparison 1.42 µm with the mask shifted half a pitch along and 1.46 µm with it shifted 5 µm across.  Over every eligible sample: the metric found an outline for 87.2 % of the 2575 eligible samples (coverage 0.872); censored null ratios 8.95 (half a pitch) and 4.19 (5 µm across); chamfer null ratios 2.62 and 1.63.  On the image: side channels at the leg's end upper side 145.5 µm (mask 143.9).  END_CHECK (the along-flow pairing): on the upper row the last pill stands 16.7 µm and the mask's last post 17.1 µm before the divider wall, no further post beyond (holds).  The centre (the scale), the pitch and the post length were measured on this micrograph: their agreement is consistency.
